verdict.rationale: Calendly's routing forms product explicitly qualifies invitees via fixed-answer logic and hidden/visible fields, then routes them to the right person or team, including automatic matching to Salesforce/HubSpot account owners and reporting on conversion by source (calendly-docs-10, calendly-docs-11, calendly-docs-43, calendly-docs-44). This is first-party documentation directly matching the story's routing/qualification/assignment intent for sales teams. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports or case studies confirming routing forms work well in practice, and no detail on team-based (vs individual) round-robin routing tied to form answers.
